:::{#sol-prereq-algebra-fraction}

The sum is $\dfrac{(n + 1)(n + 2)}{2}$.
Write $n + 1$ as $\dfrac{2(n + 1)}{2}$,
add the two fractions,
and factor out $n + 1$:

$$
\frac{n(n + 1) + 2(n + 1)}{2} = \frac{(n + 1)(n + 2)}{2}.
$$

This step appears in the [Induction](induction.qmd) chapter.
To review algebra,
see the free textbook @abramson2021algebra.

:::
